kurzfassung: The hosts discuss camping in New Brunswick, Canada, highlighting off-grid adventures and the favorable exchange rate for US travelers. They explore the critical importance of wheel position weighing for RV safety with the RV Safety and Education Foundation. Additionally, business owners share insights on running vacation rental models in the Smoky Mountains and the surging demand for premium RV rentals out west.
stichpunkte: New Brunswick offers diverse camping options from full hookups to off-grid stays and horse camping.
The US-to-Canadian dollar exchange rate provides strong purchasing advantages for American travelers.
Wheel position weighing measures individual tire loads, revealing dangerous weight imbalances that platform scales miss.
Overloading accelerates component wear and significantly increases the risk of tire blowouts and mechanical failure.
Proper weight distribution is especially critical for travel trailers to mitigate sway issues.
Setting up stationary RV vacation rentals eliminates towing stress and weekend delivery hassles for owners.
Blaxford RV Rentals has tripled its business in three years, driven by demand near major Western national parks.

clips.text: Crosses into New Brunswick from Maine and enters the Atlantic time zone, which is one of multiple unique time zones in eastern Canada.

clips.hook: RVs are houses on wheels, not empty boxes
clips.text: Unlike cargo trailers with moveable freight, recreational vehicles feature permanent heavy fixtures like tanks and appliances distributed throughout the living space.

clips.hook: The heavy cost of carrying water
clips.text: Carrying a full hundred-gallon fresh water tank adds over eight hundred pounds, which significantly restricts the remaining payload capacity.

beschreibung:
From New Brunswick camping and lobster to wheel position weighing, Smoky Mountain RV rentals, and premium national park trips, this episode helps RVers plan smarter, travel safer, and understand what every pound really means.
Discover New Brunswick camping options, from off-grid dark sky stays to full-hookup resorts, glamping, lobster, and horse camping.
Learn why wheel position weighing reveals safety issues a basic truck stop scale may miss.
Hear how Miss Daisy became a Smoky Mountains RV rental business built around setup, checklists, and real-world lessons.
Understand why premium RV rentals are growing near western national parks and who is driving that demand.

John talks with Salma Burney of the New Brunswick Campground Owners Association about camping options, history, lobster, off-grid stays, and why the exchange rate may make Canada especially appealing for American RVers.
Then Jim and Rene sit down with Trey Selman from the RV Safety & Education Foundation to explain wheel position weighing, weight distribution, tire safety, water weight, and why every item you pack matters.
Rose and Glynn talk with RV Entrepreneur Bob Ashcraft about turning "Miss Daisy" into a Smoky Mountains RV rental business and writing a book to help new campers avoid expensive lessons.
Bob wraps up with Becky Goodell, CEO of Blacksford RV Rentals, on premium RV rental growth near western national parks and why more travelers want the RV experience without buying first.
